BACK TO TOP ↑

JOURNAL / CAREER & GROWTH

Growing as a freelance digital marketer.

A strong digital practice starts with curiosity, consistency and a willingness to learn.

Build your foundations

Develop an understanding of search, content, social media and online advertising. Learn how each channel serves a different purpose, and start with the audience rather than the tool.

Learn through doing

Create a small practice project, write a content plan or review a website’s search visibility. Clearly label practice work and use it to demonstrate your thinking, not to imply client results.

Keep improving

Read marketing publications, attend workshops and test new methods. Ask what worked, what did not and what you would do differently next time.

Make your process visible

A useful portfolio explains the problem, the decisions and the learning behind the work. Clear communication and thoughtful execution are a strong foundation for lasting professional relationships.
